comparator.sourceNotes: The selected Arabic Studies specialisation closes 60+60+60 and is kept separate from Middle Eastern Studies. It includes the compulsory 30-EC Cairo semester, a 12-EC thesis and 30 EC of genuine free profiling. Diagnostic test 109121025Y and recurring tutoring 12102A025Y are mandatory zero-credit formation and do not increase the total. Current programme and course evidence support Dutch, Arabic and English instruction.

routeSelection.basis: The generic target is Arabic Language and Culture. Of the two current formal majors, Major Arabische studies directly continues the programme’s intensive Arabic-language sequence, Arabic-source work, Cairo semester and Arabic-language thesis. Major Middle Eastern Studies explicitly ends language acquisition after year 1 and is therefore less representative of the named generic bachelor. The route was selected before assessing UCR fit.

exception.reason: The corrected external curriculum is complete at 180 EC. The superseded UCR no-match judgment is preserved in remediation history for the separately excluded UCR reassessment.
